description:
Verification and hosted-write item (D7, D8). Read gh workflow view nightly-v2.yml --yaml for the dispatch inputs first (the drift domain needs run_drift=true per the existing drift items). Dispatch nightly-v2 on develop after all fix PRs have merged and a develop head containing them exists. The dispatched run's report job will comment on or close real t3:* issues; that is authorized (D7) and is also the first live proof of the new lifecycle (D1).
Expected domain outcomes (in scope): t3:docker (clickhouse, trino, postgres legs) green; t3:durations green (failing sampled tests may warn); t3:windows green; t3:throughput-cedardb green with validator_clean_rate 1.0; t3:drift green if the mirror PR was merged under D11, otherwise recorded as WAITING on that action. Out of scope and expected unchanged: t3:perf (tracked by t3-perf-aggregate-gate-tolerance-decision-20261009 and its predecessor), t3:linkcheck (external 403), anything else; record their results without acting.
After the run: for each of #2906, #2874, #2964, #3032, #2471 comment with fix PR links and the run URL; close only the ones whose domain is green (the report job may already have closed them: verify, do not duplicate). A domain that is still red for an in-scope cause: create a follow-up item with its failing signature and keep this item open.
Also verify the lifecycle live: a closed issue is reopened (not duplicated) on a later red run only if such a run occurs; otherwise record that the replay test covers it. Then finish t3-drift-corpus-mismatch-20261009 (its acceptance 3) and t3-drift-dispatch-verify-20261008 only if the run satisfies their own acceptance text read at that time.
